title: Dyson’s Strongest Vacuum Is on Sale for Dyson Week
gist: A promotional deals post: Dyson Week (through Halloween) discounts the V16 Piston Animal cordless vacuum to $820 with a Floor Dok on Dyson's site, and cuts the V8 Cyclone and V15 Detect Absolute by 33% with car-cleaning kits. Signal is limited to pre-Black Friday discounting and Dyson's direct-channel bundling versus Amazon.

insights.claim: Dyson is running a 'Dyson Week' sale through Halloween, offering discounts between Prime Day and Black Friday that would usually require waiting for a major sale holiday.
insights.speaker: Nena Farrell
insights.so_what: Brands are extending the promotional calendar beyond retailer events, signaling a heavily discounted holiday season.
